scan_table_check.description:
Flags in-progress update sets whose audit history shows they were previously Complete. If the update set was already retrieved into another instance, changes made after reopening will not reach it unless it is completed and retrieved again. Requires auditing of sys_update_set.state.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Update Set In Progress previously completed".
scan_table_check.name: SN-CFG-006: Update set reopened after completion
scan_table_check.resolution_details: If this update set was already retrieved into another instance, changes made after reopening will not reach it. Put new changes in a new update set, or complete this one again and re-retrieve it everywhere it was loaded.
scan_table_check.short_description: An in-progress update set was previously marked Complete.
scan_table_check.sys_name: SN-CFG-006: Update set reopened after completion
